Yes, it is common for neck spasm to be accompanied by dizziness or vertigo in the head, but there are other causes of dizziness and vertigo that are linked to health problems in the neck, including the following:

Sudden neck strain.
Neck disc rupture.
A deficiency in one of the vertebrae.
Myofascial pain syndrome.
Hunter syndrome.

There are also other reasons that may lead to dizziness and vertigo, including the following:

Stress and anxiety.
Benign paroxysmal positional vertigo.
Meniere's disease.
Deficiency of some vitamins and minerals.
Anemia.
Low blood pressure.
Incorrect sitting position.
Tension headache.

Neck pain accompanied by vertigo or dizziness usually does not require concern, and it goes away within a short period, especially if it is caused by an incorrect movement in the neck, but if the symptoms continue for several days, or we notice the emergence of new symptoms of numbness or the extension of the pain to other areas of the head or... يوجد العديد من الفوائد لفاكهة الرمان حيث تعتبر من الفاكهة الغنية بمضادات الأكسدة والعناصر المهمة، وقد تبين أن الرمان فعال في حالات ارتفاع ضغط الدم حيث يسبب حصول انخفاض في ضغط الدم الانقباضي (الرقم العلوي) بحوالي 5 مم زئبقي وليس له تأير على ضغط الدم الانبساطي (الرقم السفلي)، لذا يمكن إضافته للنظام الغذائي مع ضرورة اتباع تعليمات الطبيب حول الأدوية والعلاج المستخدم.
أما بالنسبة لتأثير الرمان على الدهون والكوليسترول، فيعتبر فعال جداً حيث يمنع من تراكم الكوليسترول في الشرايين ويساعد في التقليل من تأكسد البروتين الدهني منخفض الكثافة المعروف أيضًا باسم الكوليسترول الضار (LDL) مما يقلل من خطر الإصابة بالجلطات الدموية وأمراض القلب.
ينصح بالاعتدال في استهلاك الرمان، وتجنب شرب عصير الرمان الذي يحتوي على السكر مع ضرورة استشارة الطبيب حول شرب الرمان مع الأدوية المستخدمة لتجنب أي تداخلات دوائية غير مرغوبة.

Question_eng: Is pomegranate good for blood pressure and triglycerides?
Answer_eng:
There are many benefits to the pomegranate fruit, as it is considered one of the fruits rich in antioxidants and important elements. It has been shown that pomegranate is effective in cases of high blood pressure, as it causes a decrease in systolic blood pressure (the upper number) by about 5 mmHg and has no effect on diastolic blood pressure ( Bottom number), so it can be added to the diet while following the doctor’s instructions about the medications and treatment used.
As for the effect of pomegranate on fats and cholesterol, it is considered very effective as it prevents the accumulation of cholesterol in the arteries and helps reduce the oxidation of low-density lipoprotein, also known as harmful cholesterol (LDL), which reduces the risk of blood clots and heart disease.
It is recommended to consume pomegranates in moderation, avoid drinking pomegranate juice that contains sugar, and consult a doctor about drinking pomegranates with the medications used to avoid any unwanted drug interactions.

Question: انا من بداية شهر رمضان وانا لا انام عندي ارق بسبب كثر التفكير لو نمت انام 3ساعات فقط واظل صاحية اخذت دواء منوم وأخاف ان ادمنه
Answer:
يتغير الروتين اليومي في حياتنا خلال شهر رمضان المبارك نظراً لكوننا نصوم عن الطعام والشراب من الفجر وحتى المغرب. ويمكن أن يؤدي هذا التغيير إلى حدوث اضطرابات النوم في رمضان، والتسبب بحدوث الارق في رمضان. 
ويرجع سبب الإفراط في التفكير في الليل إلى حد كبير إلى معالجة الدماغ لما يحدث لنا خلال النهار. نظراً لأن أيامنا مليئة الآن بالكثير من المتغيرات والأحداث، ونستقبل المزيد من المعلومات بشكل يومي، فلا يكون لدينا متسعاً لمعالجة أفكارنا على مدار اليوم.
وإذا كنت لا تستطيع التوقف عن النوم وتكافح من أجل النوم، أو تستيقظ كثيراً في الليل بأفكار سلبية أو مستمرة، فهناك بعض الأمور التي يمكن اتباعها للتخلص من هذه المشكلة، وتشمل:

ينصح بتخصيص وقت للاسترخاء لمدة ساعة على الأقل قبل التخطيط للذهاب إلى الفراش.
ينصح بالتحدث مع شريك، أو أحد أفراد الأسرة، أو صديق حول الأفكار التي تشغل بالك. 
ينصح بالكتابة في دفتر يوميات إذا لم يكن لديك أي شخص للدردشة معه، أو إذا كنت تفضل الكتابة على إجراء محادثة مع شخص ما حول أفكارك.
ينصح بأخذ حمام ساخن لتدفئة الجسم وتسهيل الخلود إلى النوم، ويمكن أن يفي الوضوء بماء ساخن الغرض.
ينصح بالذهاب إلى النوم فقط عند الشعور بالنعاس.
ينصح باستخدام السرير فقط لغايات النوم والاسترخاء، وليس للقراءة، أو تصفح الهاتف الذكي، أو غيرها من الأنشطة.
ينصح بترك السرير ومحاولة القيام بأي عمل حتى يشعر الشخص بالنعاس في حال عدم التمكن من النوم خلال 20 دقيقة من المحاولة.
ينصح بالمحافظة على نظام ثابت للنوم خلال كل الأيام والالتزام به حتى في أيام العطلة.
ينصح بتجنب تناول المشروبات المحتوية على الكافيين قبل 4 ساعات على الأقل من وقت النوم.

أما بالنسبة للمنوم، فينصح بالابتعاد عنه واتباع النصائح المذكورة أعلاه، كما ينبغي التأكيد على أهمية استشارة الطبيب المختص قبل تناول أي دواء منوم او مهدئ، والتحدث مع الطبيب حول الخيارات العلاجية البديلة المتوفرة.

Question_eng: Since the beginning of the month of Ramadan, I have not been sleeping. I have insomnia due to overthinking. If I sleep, I will sleep for only 3 hours and remain awake. I took sleeping medication and I am afraid that I will become addicted to it.
Answer_eng:
The daily routine in our lives changes during the holy month of Ramadan, as we fast from food and drink from dawn until sunset. This change can lead to sleep disturbances in Ramadan, and cause insomnia in Ramadan. 
The reason we overthink at night is largely due to the brain's processing of what happens to us during the day. Because our days are now filled with so many variables and events, and we receive more information on a daily basis, we don't have the space to process our thoughts throughout the day.
If you cannot stop sleeping and struggle to sleep, or you wake up often at night with negative or persistent thoughts, there are some things that can be followed to get rid of this problem, including:

It is recommended to set aside time to relax for at least an hour before planning to go to bed.
It is recommended to talk to a partner, family member, or friend about the thoughts that are troubling your mind. 
Writing in a journal is recommended if you don't have anyone to chat with, or if you prefer writing to having a conversation with someone about your thoughts.
It is recommended to take a hot bath to warm the body and make it easier to fall asleep. Ablution with hot water can do the trick.
It is recommended to go to sleep only when you feel sleepy.
It is recommended to use the bed only for sleeping and relaxing purposes, and not for reading, browsing a smartphone, or other activities.

The reasons for the appearance of a pimple on the eyelid sometimes do not cause concern and may go away without any treatment, but if the presence of this pimple causes any pain, does not respond to home treatments, or has any effect on vision, you must consult a doctor.

Tear duct obstruction.

Blepharitis.

Do not poke it, press it, or try to open it. This could increase its risk.
Place a warm, wet cloth on the affected eye several times a day.
Gently massage the swollen area to help unclog the blocked gland.

Question_eng: What causes pain in the rib cage?
Answer_eng:
There are many reasons that lead to the development of rib cage pain or pain that refers to the areas surrounding the ribs of the rib cage, and it is not possible to know the cause of rib cage pain without consulting a specialist doctor, conducting a clinical examination, pictures, tests, taking a medical history, and other necessary steps to determine the cause of rib cage bone pain. .
Rib cage bone pain can develop due to one of the following reasons:

Common musculoskeletal causes include all of the following:


Suffering from an injury to one of the ribs in the rib cage, leading to a fracture or bruise in one of the ribs.
Inflammation of the costochondritis, which is the cartilage that connects the ribs of the rib cage to the sternum.
Fibromyalgia.
Having a rheumatic condition such as rheumatoid arthritis.


Less common musculoskeletal causes include all of the following:


Stress fracture of the ribs, which develops as a result of excessive exercise in certain activities.
Tietze syndrome, which is inflammation and swelling of the cartilage at the end of the ribs.
Malignant tumors such as lung or breast cancer.
Rheumatic diseases such as lupus and others.


Causes not related to the musculoskeletal system, including the following:


Shingles or Zona disease.
Heart-related diseases, such as heart attack, pericarditis, etc.
Cardiovascular disease, including aortic enlargement.
Lung-related diseases such as pneumonia, lung cancer, pulmonary embolism, etc.
Pleurisy or fluid accumulation between the pleura.
splenomegaly.
Liver diseases such as hepatitis.
Gastrointestinal disorders.
Gallstones or cholecystitis.
Pancreatitis or pancreatic tumors.
Kidney and ureter problems.

It is recommended to consult a doctor, especially if any of the following symptoms appear:

Feeling of pressure on the chest.
Pain in the rib cage that radiates to the arms, back, or jaw.
Heart rhythm disturbances.
Shortness of breath.
Severe pain.
Sudden sweating.
Vertigo.
Confusion or loss of consciousness.
Cough accompanied by blood.
Difficulty swallowing.
Tingling or numbness in the arms or legs.

Question_eng: Do depression medications lower blood pressure?
Answer_eng:
Some people may wonder: Do depression medications reduce blood pressure? Or do depression medications lower blood pressure? Depression and blood pressure medications affect some neurotransmitters in the body, such as serotonin, norepinephrine, and dopamine. There is much research on antidepressants and anti-hypertensive agents, but there is no fixed rule.
Many people are looking for antidepressants for patients with high blood pressure, as there is concern about high or low blood pressure and the resulting complications. There is concern about medications for depression and low blood pressure. Depression medications that lower blood pressure include the following:

Monoamine oxidase inhibitor.
Selective serotonin and noradrenaline reuptake inhibitor.

On the other hand, questions may arise about medications for depression and high blood pressure. Options for medications for depression and high blood pressure include the following:

Tricyclic antidepressants.
Monoamine oxidase inhibitor when taken with foods containing tyramine.
Selective serotonin and noradrenaline reuptake inhibitor.
Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors.

It is recommended that you monitor your blood pressure readings on a regular basis if you are taking any antidepressants, and that you should consult a specialist doctor if your blood pressure is irregular or very high to regulate the medications used.

Answer:
يحتوي دواء جوسبرين اقراص مغلفة (بالإنجليزية:Jusprin Enteric Coated Tablets) أو دواء الأسبرين (بالإنجليزية: Aspirin)، على مادة اسيتيل ساليسيلك اسيد (بالإنجليزية:  Acetylsalicylic Acid) كمادة فعالة، ويستخدم بشكلٍ عام كمسكن عام للجسم وخافض للحرارة، فهو ينتمي لمجموعة مضادات الالتهاب غير الستيرويدية (بالإنجليزية: Non steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs).
ويستخدم الأسبرين لعلاج وتسكين العديد من الأمراض والآلام، منها:

الألم في أي مكان في الجسم.
يقلل من حدوث بعض المشاكل والأمراض الخاصة بالقلب والأوعية الدموية.
يقلل ويعالج المشاكل الخاصة بالشريان التاجي في القلب.
يساعد في منع حدوث تسمم الحمل (بالإنجليزية: Preeclampsia) وارتفاع ضغط الدم للحامل.

يصف الاطباء عادة دواء الأسبرين بجرعة منخفضة للحوامل اللاتي لديهن عامل خطر للإصابة بتسمم الحمل أو بعض الأمراض والمشاكل الأخرى، ومن هذه العوامل:

وجود تاريخ سابق لتسمم الحمل.
مرور الأم بولادات متعددة سابقة.
إصابة الأم بارتفاع ضغط الدم المزمن.
إصابة الام بداء السكري.
اصابة الأم بأحد أمراض الكلى.
إصابة الأم بأحد أمراض المناعة الذاتية، مثل مرض الذئبة الحمراء (بالإنجليزية: Lupus).
عمر الأم فوق 35 سنة.

وجود فارق يعادل 10 سنوات بين الحمل الحالي والسابق.

Question_eng: I took two baby aspirin pills, Joe Aspirin, while I was pregnant, and the doctor said one pill. Is there any harm to me or the fetus?
Answer_eng:
Jusprin Enteric Coated Tablets, or aspirin, contain acetylsalicylic acid as the active ingredient. It is generally used as a general analgesic for the body and an antipyretic. It belongs to the group of anti-inflammatory drugs. Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs.
Aspirin is used to treat and relieve many diseases and pains, including:

Pain anywhere in the body.
It reduces the occurrence of some problems and diseases related to the heart and blood vessels.
Reduces and treats problems related to the coronary artery in the heart.
It helps prevent preeclampsia and high blood pressure in pregnant women.

Doctors usually prescribe low-dose aspirin for pregnant women who have a risk factor for preeclampsia or some other diseases and problems, and these factors include:

Having a previous history of preeclampsia.
The mother has had multiple previous births.
The mother suffers from chronic high blood pressure.
The mother has diabetes.
The mother suffers from a kidney disease.
The mother has an autoimmune disease, such as lupus.
Mother's age is over 35 years.
The mother is morbidly obese.
There is a difference equivalent to 10 years between the current and previous pregnancy.

Jospirin is used for pregnant women by taking one tablet (81 mg) daily during the middle and last three months of pregnancy, to reduce the occurrence of preeclampsia and its risks under the supervision of a specialist doctor only.
To answer your question about “I took two aspirin pills while I was pregnant,” the correct dose is one pill daily, so you must consult a doctor to ensure that taking two pills of Jospirin in the past is not dangerous.
Taking a high dose of aspirin for pregnant women may be considered relatively dangerous, depending on the stage of pregnancy, as during the first three months of pregnancy, the use of higher doses of aspirin poses a concern for pregnancy loss and birth defects, and taking higher doses of aspirin during the third trimester of pregnancy leads to Increased risk of premature closure of blood vessels in the fetal heart. Use of high-dose aspirin for long periods during pregnancy also increases the risk of bleeding in the brain of premature babies.

Question: أسباب و علاج السعال الليلي عند الأطفال؟!
Answer:
تعتبر حالات السعال عند الأطفال من الأمور المزعجة في بعض الأحيان لكل من الأطفال والوالدين، ولكن ما هو السعال الليلي عند الطفل؟ يشير هذا المصطلح إلى زيادة عدد مرات السعال في فترة الليل وأثناء نوم الطفل، وقد تتحسن معظم حالات السعال الليلي عند الأطفال خلال بضعة أسابيع إلا أنها قد تستمر في بعض الأحيان وتصبح مزمنة. ويجب أن يتم تقييم الحالة من قبل الطبيب المختص لتحديد أسباب السعال الليلي عند الأطفال حيث قد تشمل أحد الحالات التالية:

السعال نتيجة التنقيط الأنفي الخلفي، حيث قد يشعر بعض الأطفال بتراكم المخاط وتقطيره في الحلق نتيجة تراكمه بالمجاري التنفسية في العديد من حالات الالتهابات والحساسية. وقد يتم اللجوء في هذه الحالة إلى تعديل وضعية نوم الطفل وتحديد مهيجات السعال لتجنبها مع تحديد العلاج المناسب من قبل الطبيب المختص.
الإصابة بالخناق أو السعال الذي يشبه صوت النباح خاصة بعد إصابة الجهاز التنفسي بالعدوى الفيروسية وانتفاخ القصبات الهوائية والتهاب الأحبال الصوتية.
السعال الديكي الذي يتطور نتيجة عدوى بكتيرية تصيب القناة التنفسية، ويجب أن يتم علاج الحالة تحت إشراف الطبيب عن طريق المضادات الحيوية تحت إشراف الطبيب والإكثار من شرب السوائل.
الربو، وقد تظهر أعراض السعال في هذه الحالة يرافقها الأزيز أي صوت الصفير الذي يخرج من الصدر ويجب أن يتم تحديد علاج من قبل الطبيب للتخفيف من النوبات بالإضافة للعلاج طويل الأمد.

Question_eng: Causes and treatment of night cough in children?!
Answer_eng:
Coughs in children are sometimes annoying matters for both children and parents, but what is a nighttime cough in a child? This term refers to an increase in the number of coughing times at night and while the child is sleeping. Most cases of nighttime coughing in children may improve within a few weeks, but sometimes they may continue and become chronic. The condition must be evaluated by a specialist doctor to determine the causes of nighttime coughing in children, as it may include one of the following conditions:

Cough is a result of postnasal drip, as some children may feel mucus accumulating and dripping in the throat as a result of its accumulation in the respiratory tract in many cases of infections and allergies. In this case, we may resort to adjusting the child’s sleeping position and identifying cough irritants to avoid them, along with determining the appropriate treatment by the specialist doctor.
Croup or a cough that resembles a barking sound, especially after the respiratory system is infected with a viral infection, swelling of the bronchial tubes, and inflammation of the vocal cords.
Whooping cough develops as a result of a bacterial infection affecting the respiratory tract. The condition must be treated under the supervision of a doctor using antibiotics under the doctor’s supervision and drinking plenty of fluids.
Asthma. Symptoms of cough may appear in this case, accompanied by wheezing, that is, the whistling sound that comes out of the chest. Treatment must be determined by the doctor to alleviate the attacks, in addition to long-term treatment.
Infection with the Corona virus (Covid-19), in which children suffer from a cough that is accompanied by an increase in body temperature.
Seasonal allergies or allergies to bed mites or the quality of fabrics, etc.

It is recommended to follow the following tips to relieve nighttime coughing in children:

Try to try taking a warm water bath before bed.
Get enough rest.
Make sure the child gets plenty of fluids.
Be careful to avoid giving honey to children under the age of 12 months.
Work to see a specialist doctor as soon as possible.

Question: هل يسبب التهاب الاذن والجيوب الم في المعدة???
Answer:
أود الإشارة بداية أن التهاب الأذن والجيوب الأنفية لا يؤدي إلى المعاناة من ألم المعدة بشكل مباشر، ولكن قد يعاني البعض من اضطرابات هضمية أثناء الإصابة بهذا النوع من الالتهاب، فما هو الرابط بين التهاب الأذن والجيوب والمعدة، وهل الجيوب الأنفية تؤثر على المعدة؟ 
قد تؤدي الإصابة بالتهاب الأذن والجيوب الأنفية إلى حدوث ما يعرف بالتنقيط الأنفي الخلفي (بالإنجليزية: Sinusitis)، ويتمثل بالسائل المخاطي الذي قد ينزل من التجويف الأنفي إلى الحلق ومنه إلى المعدة، وقد يسبب تراكم السائل المخاطي في المعدة أثناء المرض إلى الشعور بالغثيان أو التقيؤ في بعض الحالات، وهو ما قد يؤدي إلى شعور الشخص بالاضطراب أو الألم في المعدة.
يجدر الذكر أن بعض الأدوية المستخدمة في علاج الجيوب الأنفية والتهاب الأذن قد تؤدي إلى الشعور بألم أو اضطراب في المعدة أو الجهاز الهضمي بشكل عام، أو قد يكون ألم المعدة مصاحباً لالتهاب الأذن والجيوب الأنفية ولكنه ناجماً عن أسباب أخرى، فهناك العديد من الأسباب المختلفة التي قد تؤدي إلى الشعور بألم في المعدة أو البطن، وغالباً ما تكون أسباب بسيطة.
أود لفت انتباهك إلى ضرورة مراجعة طبيب مختص في حال ملاحظة زيادة شدة ألم المعدة أو مصاحبته لأعراض أخرى غير اعتيادية، يجدر الذكر أيضاً أنه قد يصعب تمييز مصدر الألم في البطن فهناك العديد من الأعضاء المتجاورة داخل البطن، وسوف أبين لك في ما يأتي مجموعة من الأسباب الأخرى التي قد تؤدي إلى الشعور بألم في المعدة:

عسر الهضم.
تراكم الغازات وانتفاخ البطن.
التسمم الغذائي.
الإمساك والإسهال.
الحساسية تجاه بعض أنواع الطعام، أو عدم تحمل بعض الأطعمة.

A pregnant woman over 18 years of age needs 1,000 mg of calcium per day throughout her pregnancy. Calcium can also be obtained from nutritional supplements and food sources, which include:

Calcium-fortified cereals.
orange juice.
Soy drinks.
Yoghurt and milk.
Sardines and salmon.
Cheddar cheese.
Tofu.

When taking calcium, the following tips should be taken into account:

Do not take calcium pills that contain more than 500 mg at a time, as absorption is better.
Avoid excessive consumption of calcium from its sources, as consuming more than 2,500 grams per day leads to kidney stones and reduced absorption of zinc and iron.
Drink sufficient amounts of water and eat fiber, as calcium leads to constipation.
Avoid consuming calcium and iron at the same time as they should be separated by at least several hours.

As for any other medications suitable for you or your child at this time, they must be determined by the specialist doctor according to the condition and the results of the analysis, if necessary. It is preferable not to use any medication during pregnancy without consulting a doctor or health care provider to ensure its safe use.

Question: ابغا اشفط دهون زنودي وماهي كبيره مراا لأن جسمي نحيف وهيا زايده
Answer:
شفط الدهون هو إجراء جراحي يتضمن شفط الخلايا الدهنية الزائدة، وهو إجراء غير مؤلم، يتضمن إدخال قنيات صغيرة (3 إلى 4 مم) بحواف مستديرة، متصلة بواسطة نظام شفط يمتص كل الدهون المتراكمة.
تجرى عملية شفط الدهون في حالات زيادة الدهون الموضعية المقاومة للحمية والرياضة. تزيد الدهون الموضعية في الرجال عند الثنيات على جانبي البطن والبطن والظهر والصدر والرقبة وفي حالة التثدي، أما في النساء فيشمل ذلك البطن والفخذين والوركين والأرداف والذراعين والذقن المزدوجة.
يوصى بشفط الدهون بعد 18 عاماً وقبل 60 عاماً.
الهدف من شفط الدهون هو إيجاد صورة متناغمة وخالية من الدهون الزائدة، لذا فهو إجراء تجميلي وليس وسيلة لإنقاص الوزن بالأساس، وتكون نتيجته حاسمة إذا كان المريض يتبع أسلوب حياة صحي مثل:

تناول الطعام الصحي.
مارس الرياضة.
تجنب الكحول والسجائر.

تُجرى العملية عادةً تحت تأثير التخدير العام، وتظهر النتيجة النهائية لشفط الدهون بعد 6 أشهر، وهو الوقت الذي يتراجع فيه الجلد ويمتزج مع الصورة الظلية الجديدة.
لا تجدد الخلايا الدهنية التي تم شفطها مما يعطي عملية شفط الدهون نتيجة نهائية.
 هناك أضرار محتملة بعد عملية الشفط منها:

ثقب أو إصابة الأعضاء الداخلية: نتيجة دخول الكانيولا المستخدم لاستخراج الدهون من الجسم، واختراقه إلى الداخل بعمق، وثقب أحد الأعضاء الداخلية.
حروق بالجلد: بسبب المعدات المستخدمة في عملية شفط الدهون مثل حروق الموجات فوق الصوتية أو حروق احتكاك في الجلد والأعصاب نتيجةً لحركة الكانيولا أثناء شفط الدهون.
الجلطات الدهنية وانسداد الأوعية الدموية.
التورم وتراكم السوائل.
حدوث عدوى جلدية: تحدث أثناء إجراء جراحة شفط الدهون.
الإصابة بالتهاب الوريد الخثاري.
حدوث ردود الفعل التحسسية سواء من الأدوية أو أي من المواد المستخدمة أثناء الجراحة. 

لذا عليك استشارة طبيب اختصاصي التجميل والتحدث معه، ومناقشة عملية شفط الدهون قبل إجرائها.

Question_eng: I want to get liposuction on my ovaries and they are not too big because my body is thin and they are fat
Answer_eng:
Liposuction is a surgical procedure that involves suctioning out excess fat cells. It is a painless procedure, which involves the insertion of small cannulas (3 to 4 mm) with rounded edges, connected by a suction system that sucks out all the accumulated fat.
Liposuction is performed in cases of excess local fat that is resistant to diet and exercise. Local fat increases in men in the folds on the sides of the abdomen, abdomen, back, chest, neck, and in the case of gynecomastia, while in women this includes the abdomen, thighs, hips, buttocks, arms, and double chin.
Liposuction is recommended after 18 years and before 60 years.
The goal of liposuction is to create a harmonious image free of excess fat, so it is a cosmetic procedure and not primarily a way to lose weight. Its result is decisive if the patient follows a healthy lifestyle, such as:

Eat healthy.
Exercise.
Avoid alcohol and cigarettes.

The procedure is usually performed under general anesthesia, and the final result of liposuction is visible after 6 months, which is when the skin retracts and blends into the new silhouette.
The suctioned fat cells do not regenerate, which gives the liposuction process a final result.
 There are possible damages after the suction procedure, including:

Perforation or injury to the internal organs: as a result of the cannula used to extract fat from the body, penetrating deeply into the interior, and puncturing one of the internal organs.
Skin burns: due to the equipment used in the liposuction process, such as ultrasound burns or friction burns in the skin and nerves as a result of the movement of the cannula during liposuction.
Fatty clots and blood vessel blockage.
Swelling and fluid accumulation.
Skin infection: occurs during liposuction surgery.
Thrombophlebitis.
The occurrence of allergic reactions to either medications or any of the materials used during surgery. 

Therefore, you should consult a plastic surgeon, talk to him, and discuss the liposuction procedure before performing it.

Question_eng: I have an enlarged prostate. I don't know the reason. When I sleep, I feel it, but when I stand and move, I feel like I'm making a bag full of water.
Answer_eng:
Enlargement of the prostate gland is called benign prostatic hyperplasia, and its incidence increases with age. Benign prostatic hyperplasia is a benign, non-cancerous enlargement of the prostate that prevents the flow of urine through the urethra. Prostate cells gradually multiply, leading to an enlargement that puts pressure on the urethra through which urine and semen exit the body. It is worth noting that other symptoms appear, such as a weak or slow urinary stream, a feeling of not emptying the bladder, difficulty in starting urination, frequent urination, and others. It is preferable to consult a specialist doctor as soon as possible so that he can give the appropriate treatment before any complications occur or the condition develops.

Question_eng: Delayed menstruation and clear secretions - does this indicate pregnancy?
Answer_eng:
Vaginal discharge is a fluid that flows through the vagina, to keep it clean and moist and to prevent infection. If the menstrual period is delayed with clear secretions, it may indicate one of the following conditions:

The presence of a fibroadenoma.
Presence of pregnancy.
A woman is infected with a sexually transmitted disease.
Use a contraceptive method.

It is preferable to consult a doctor so that he can perform the necessary tests and tests to confirm the presence of pregnancy, especially if any of the following symptoms appear:

Vaginal discharge more than usual.
Change in color or smell of vaginal discharge.
Bleeding between menstrual periods, or after intercourse.
Pain when urinating.
Pain and itching in the vaginal area.
Pain in the pelvic area.

You should also know that there are many initial signs of pregnancy other than discharge, which include the following:

Missed menstruation.
Swelling and pain in the breast.
Increased frequency of urination.
Feeling nauseous with or without vomiting.
Women feel exhausted and tired.

لا، لن يظهر الحمل في تحليل البول المنزلي إذا كان عمره أسبوعًا واحدًا، فعادةً ما يظهر الحمل في تحليل البول المنزلي بعد حوالي 14 يومًا من غياب الدورة الشهرية، وذلك لأن هرمون الحمل والذي يُسمى موجهة الغدد التناسلية المشيمية البشرية (hCG)، يحتاج إلى بعض الوقت حتى يتراكم في البول بمستويات كافية لكشفه.

Question_eng: Is the gestational age one week shown in a home urine test? If the answer is no, when does pregnancy appear in a home urine test?
Answer_eng:
No, pregnancy will not appear on a home urine test if it is one week old. Pregnancy usually appears on a home urine test about 14 days after the absence of a menstrual period. This is because the pregnancy hormone, called human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG), requires some time until it accumulates in urine at sufficient levels for detection.
 
It is generally recommended to perform a home pregnancy test the day after the menstrual cycle stops to give sufficient time for pregnancy hormone levels to rise in the blood and urine. However, in general, pregnancy can be detected approximately ten days after the success of the pregnancy, but the chances of a false negative result appearing are high in this case.
 
Therefore, if you think you are pregnant, it is best to take a home pregnancy test after a missed period. If the result is negative, you can repeat the test after a week. However, if the result of the home pregnancy test is positive, in this case you must see a doctor to ensure the safety of the pregnancy and take appropriate measures to maintain the health of the pregnancy.

There are several possible reasons for weight change despite you sticking to the same diet, and the following is an explanation of some of these reasons:

Excessive physical activity: Increasing your physical activity or exercising regularly may have led to burning additional calories and thus losing weight.
Change in hormonal balance: The hormonal balance in your body, such as thyroid hormones, can affect metabolism and thus can affect weight.
Change in metabolic rate: There may be a change in your metabolic rate, which is the amount of calories your body needs to maintain your weight, which affects weight loss.
Health problems: There may be undiagnosed health problems that caused weight loss, in which case it is important to consult a doctor to evaluate your condition.
Changes in eating habits: You may have made unconscious changes in your dietary pattern or the amount of calories you consume, resulting in weight loss.
Stress and psychological pressures: Stress and ongoing psychological pressures may lead to changes in appetite and metabolism, which affects weight.

It is best to consult your doctor to evaluate your health condition and determine the possible reasons for weight loss, and to deny the presence of serious health reasons or reasons that require treatment without delay.

Answer_eng:
Tuberculosis is a bacterial infection that is spread by inhaling the cough or sneeze of another person who has TB. It mainly affects the lungs and can be treated by choosing appropriate antibiotics for a certain period that may extend to 6 months.
Certain symptoms appear that may indicate tuberculosis, such as:

Lack of appetite
Weight loss
fever
Night sweats
Extreme fatigue
Persistent cough with bloody phlegm
Shortness of breath that gets progressively worse
Swelling of the lymph or salivary glands. 

You must consult a doctor to perform examinations, analyzes and pictures designated for diagnosing tuberculosis. It is recommended to consult him to confirm the nature of the infection, whether bacterial or viral. It must be known that the medicine that is prescribed to treat the infection must be taken for a certain period before it takes effect.

Question_eng: Does urine infection cause delayed pregnancy?
Answer_eng:
Urinary tract infection affects the kidneys, uterus, bladder, and other organs responsible for eliminating body waste. If the infection is repeated more than once or remains untreated for a long time, this may lead to obstruction of pregnancy and some fertility problems, especially in the case of pelvic inflammatory disease. Or if it affects the fallopian tube. Also, having urinary tract infections can affect the ovulation process and thus delay pregnancy.
In all cases, you must visit a doctor to perform the necessary tests in order to determine the appropriate treatment, while taking into account the following tips:

Maintaining personal hygiene.
Drink plenty of water.
Wear cotton underwear.
Going to the bathroom to urinate when you feel the need to urinate.
Avoid excessive use of products and washes designed to clean the genital areas.
Use nutritional supplements that contain probiotics.

Question: لماذا يستخدم علاج dolorex
Answer:
يحتوي دواء دولوريكس (بالإنجليزية: Dolorex) على المادة الفعالة ديكلوفيناك البوتاسيوم (بالإنجليزية: Diclofenac Potassium)، وهو أحد الأدوية التي تنتمي إلى فئة مضادات الالتهاب غير الستيرويدية (بالإنجليزية: Nonsteroidal Anti-inflammatory Drug).
يستخدم دواء دولوريكس أو أي من الأدوية التي تنتمي إلى فئة مضادات الالتهاب غير الستيرويدية بشكل عام في تخفيف الألم، والتخفيف من الالتهاب، وخفض حرارة الجسم، بالإضافة إلى علاج الوذمة، أما بالنسبة للحالات التي قد يتم فيها وصف الدواء فقد تتضمن الآتي:

تسكين الألم بمختلف أشكاله، مثل المصاب لبعض الأمراض، أو الناجم عن الإصابات.
التخفيف من آلام الدورة الشهرية.
التخفيف من التهاب وانتفاخ المفاصل.
التخفيف من أعراض بعض الأمراض المزمنة، مثل التهاب المفاصل الروماتويدي، والتهاب الفقرات التصلبي، والصداع النصفي.

يحتوي دواء دولوريكس على حبوب فموية، ويجب الحرص على تناول الدواء مع كمية كافية من الماء للمساعدة على دفع الحبة إلى داخل المعدة وتجنب التصاقها في المريء، كما ينصح بتجنب الاستلقاء حتى 10 دقائق على الأقل بعد تناول حبة الدواء، وتجنب تناول الدواء على معدة فارغة.
يتوفر دواء دولوريكس دون وصفة طبية، ويمكن استخدامه بهدف التخفيف من أعراض بعض الاضطرابات الصحية البسيطة دون استشارة الطبيب، ولكن يجب الحرص على الالتزام بالجرعة المذكورة في النشرة الدوائية، كما يجب الحرص على تجنب استخدام دواء دولوريكس لفترات طويلة بسبب ارتفاع خطر الإصابة بقرحة المعدة، لذلك يجب استشارة الطبيب حول الأدوية البديلة المناسبة للاستخدام على فترات طويلة.
قد يصاحب استخدام دواء دولوريكس مجموعة من الآثار الجانبية الشائعة، والتي تتضمن الآتي:

احتقان الأنف.
عسر الهضم، ألم المعدة.
النفخة والغازات.
الإمساك أو الإسهال.
الحكة.
التعرق.
التأثير في نتائج بعض التحاليل المخبرية.

توجد مجموعة من الحالات التي يجدر فيها تجنب استخدام دواء دولوريكس، أو اقتصار استخدام الدواء تحت الإشراف الطبي المباشر فقط، ومنها الآتي:

تناول دواء الأسبرين.
المعاناة من أحد اضطرابات القلب، أو ارتفاع ضغط الدم.
الإصابة بأحد أمراض الكلى أو الكبد.
الإصابة بقرحة المعدة أو نزيف المعدة.
الإصابة بمرض الربو.

Question_eng: Why is dolorex treatment used?
Answer_eng:
Dolorex contains the active ingredient diclofenac potassium, which is one of the medicines that belong to the category of non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs.
Dolorex or any of the medications belonging to the category of non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs is generally used to relieve pain, reduce inflammation, and lower body temperature, in addition to treating edema. As for the cases in which the medication may be prescribed, it may include the following:

Alleviating pain in its various forms, such as those suffering from certain diseases or resulting from injuries.
Alleviating menstrual pain.
Alleviating inflammation and swelling of joints.
Alleviating the symptoms of some chronic diseases, such as rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, and migraines.

Dolorex contains oral pills, and you must be careful to take the medication with a sufficient amount of water to help push the pill into the stomach and avoid it sticking to the esophagus. It is also recommended to avoid lying down until at least 10 minutes after taking the pill, and to avoid taking the medication on an empty stomach.
Dolorex is available without a prescription, and it can be used to alleviate the symptoms of some minor health disorders without consulting a doctor, but care must be taken to adhere to the dosage mentioned in the medication leaflet, and care must also be taken to avoid using Dolurex for long periods due to the high risk of stomach ulcers, so You should consult a doctor about alternative medications suitable for use over long periods.

Nasal congestion.
Indigestion, stomach pain.
Bloating and gas.
Constipation or diarrhea.
Itching.
Sweating.
Influencing the results of some laboratory tests.

There are a group of cases in which it is necessary to avoid using Dolurex, or to limit the use of the drug under direct medical supervision only, including the following:

Take aspirin.
Suffering from a heart disorder or high blood pressure.
Suffering from kidney or liver disease.
Stomach ulcers or stomach bleeding.
Suffering from asthma.
Smoking.

Question_eng: How do I eliminate dandruff? Is there an effective shampoo that you recommend? Thank you
Answer_eng:
Dandruff, which often occurs due to dry scalp, can be eliminated by following these steps:

Avoid using hair products that contain alcohol as they can worsen dandruff by increasing the dryness of the scalp.
Avoid oily hair products.
Moisturize the hair and scalp by using a cleansing shampoo, then a hair conditioner, and rinsing the hair well with water afterward.
Try hair products containing zinc pyrithione as it is gentle on the skin and can be used on a daily basis.
Consult your doctor before trying hair products that contain selenium sulfide or coal tar, especially if you have gray or blonde hair.
Consult your doctor about using shampoo that contains ketoconazole.
Consult your doctor about using hair products that contain salicylic acid.
Use hair products that contain tea tree oil.

It is recommended to consult a dermatologist if the above tips do not work, as there are other treatment options that contain substances in certain proportions that are prohibited from being used without the supervision of a specialist doctor.

Answer_eng:
You must consult a specialist doctor immediately to conduct the necessary tests for you and the fetus and to give you the appropriate cognitive or behavioral treatment, as exposure to panic attacks during pregnancy may lead to one of the following cases:

Low blood volume and fluid loss, where the heart becomes unable to pump enough blood to the body, leading to a low birth weight or premature birth.
Abruption of the placenta, which leads to interruption of blood supply to the fetus and thus its death.
Panic attacks affect the relationship between mother and child and the mother's ability to cope with the postpartum period.

Question_eng: How do I know if I have hemorrhoids or not, knowing that there is blood in the stool but without pain?
Answer_eng:
If you experience blood in your stool without pain, this may be a sign of internal hemorrhoids, because internal hemorrhoids are often painless and cause bleeding while passing stool.
 
It is worth noting that the presence of blood in the stool is not only conclusive evidence of the presence of hemorrhoids, but it can also be the result of other causes such as anal fissures, colon infections, the presence of intestinal tumors, or other digestive problems. Therefore, you should consult a doctor to carefully evaluate your condition and diagnose the exact cause of blood in the stool.
 
The doctor may perform a rectal examination to diagnose the condition, and sometimes the doctor may need to perform additional tests such as a colon examination or anoscopy to rule out any other diseases, so do not hesitate to share the symptoms you are experiencing with the doctor in every detail, so that he can guide you correctly. And provide appropriate treatment for your condition.

Question_eng: I suffer from a condition in which when I walk, I get swelling in my right foot and I feel severe pain in it, and the swelling remains for a certain period of time, and I suffer from weight...
Answer_eng:
Swelling of the feet is considered a common symptom that many people suffer from as a result of walking or standing for long periods. It is often treated by taking a break, raising the leg up, and trying to get rid of excess weight to reduce pressure on the feet, but it may be evidence of a more serious problem. It is dangerous and may be due to one of the following reasons:

Venous insufficiency.
Phlebitis.
Deep vein thrombosis.
Congestive heart.
Having kidney or liver problems.
Tendinitis.

Swelling in the feet is not a cause for concern, especially if it disappears within several hours, but you should consult a doctor if the swelling develops suddenly, leaves a mark when pressed with the finger, lasts more than several days, is accompanied by pain or a change in skin color, and appears in only one foot.

نعم قد يسبب القولون العصبي نبض في البطن، ولكن النبض المستمر في البطن وبشكل يومي يستدعي مراجعة الطبيب للتأكد من سبب النبض، لأن نبض البطن الناجم عن القولون العصبي قد يرتبط بالنفخة أو تناول بعض أنواع الأطعمة، ولا يكون مستمرًا.
 
يجدر الذكر أن النبض القوي في البطن قد يدل بالفعل على الإصابة بتمدد الأوعية الدموية بالأبهر البطني (بالإنجليزية: Abdominal aortic aneurysm)، ومن الأعراض الأخرى التي قد تدل على الإصابة بهذا النوع من تمدد الأوعية الدموية ما يأتي:

ألم الظهر.
الألم الشديد والعميق في البطن في منطقة سرة البطن.
تركز النبض بالقرب من سرة البطن.

أما بالنسبة لسؤالك أين يوجد ألم القولون العصبي؟ فإن ألم القولون العصبي عادةً ما يكون في أسفل البطن، ولكن يمكن أن يمتد إلى وسط البطن أو حتى أعلى البطن، ويكون الألم في كثير من الأحيان مصحوبًا بتقلصات، وقد يشعر المريض بالحاجة إلى التبرز مع الألم، وغالبًا ما يزداد الألم بعد تناول الطعام، أو عند الشعور بالتوتر أو القلق ويزول الألم بعد التبرز في الغالب.

Back pain.
Severe, deep abdominal pain in the belly button area.
The pulse is concentrated near the belly button.

In some simple cases of ventricular aortic aneurysm, it is sufficient to monitor the condition and make some lifestyle changes. However, in severe cases, surgery is performed to correct the problem before serious health complications develop.
 
As for your question, where is irritable bowel syndrome located? Irritable bowel syndrome pain is usually in the lower abdomen, but it can extend to the middle of the abdomen or even the upper abdomen. The pain is often accompanied by cramps, and the patient may feel the need to defecate with the pain. The pain often increases after eating, or When feeling stressed or anxious, the pain usually goes away after defecation.

Family training: The family must be trained on how to provide healthy and balanced nutrition for the child and maintain his health.
Follow up and monitor the child: The child must be followed and monitored regularly to ensure that his condition improves and develops properly.

Colds and influenza.

Back pain.

What Is Postprandial Hypotension?
Question_eng: What is the reason for the drop in blood pressure after lunch every day?
Answer_eng:
A fall or decrease in blood pressure after eating lunch or any meal is known as postprandial hypotension, which is a drop in blood pressure accompanied by dizziness, lightheadedness, or fainting about 1-2 hours after eating a meal. Low blood pressure after eating may be due to one of the following reasons:

The digestion process requires more blood to flow into the intestines, which leads to a decrease in the amount of blood reaching other parts of the body, which in turn causes a temporary drop in blood pressure.
Rapid absorption of sugar and glucose from the blood, which causes a decrease in blood pressure, especially in diabetics.
growing old.
Having high blood pressure and taking antihypertensive medications.

It is recommended that you consult a doctor about low blood pressure after eating if you do not suffer from any health problems, and follow the following tips:

If you are taking medications to treat high blood pressure, it is recommended to adjust the timing of taking the dose by avoiding taking the dose before a meal.
Consult your doctor about the need to adjust the dosage of high blood pressure medications used.
Reducing the amount of carbohydrates consumed.
Eat meals more frequently and in smaller portions instead of 3 large main meals.
Exercising after meals.

Question: هل السردين مضر للمرأة، وهل سمك السردين يحتوي على الزئبق؟
Answer:
لا، السردين ليس ضارًا للمرأة ويمكن للمرأة أن تتناوله بشكل آمن كجزء من نظامها الغذائي المتوازن، ويعتبر السردين مصدرًا ممتازًا للبروتين والأحماض الدهنية الأوميغا-3، والتي تعتبر مفيدة لصحة القلب والأوعية الدموية والدماغ.
 
يحتوي سمك السردين على نسبة منخفضة من الزئبق، وهو معدن ثقيل يمكن أن يكون ضارًا عند تناوله بكميات كبيرة، ولكن فوائد تناول سمك السردين تتفوق على المخاطر المحتملة للزئبق فيه، ويمكن تناوله بشكل آمن بكميات معتدلة.
 
ينصح بتناول السردين المعلب من الأنواع المعبأة في الماء، حيث يكون مستوى الزئبق فيها أقل من الأنواع المعبأة في الزيت، ويمكن للمرأة الحامل أو المرضع أن تتناول سمك السردين بكميات معتدلة، والتي تتراوح بين 2-3 وجبات في الأسبوع. ويجب استشارة الطبيب إذا كانت المرأة تعاني من أي حالة صحية تستدعي تقييد تناول السمك.

Question_eng: Are sardines harmful to women, and do sardines contain mercury?
Answer_eng:
No, sardines are not harmful to women and women can safely eat them as part of their balanced diet. Sardines are an excellent source of protein and omega-3 fatty acids, which are beneficial for cardiovascular and brain health.
 
Sardines contain a low percentage of mercury, a heavy metal that can be harmful when eaten in large quantities, but the benefits of eating sardines outweigh the potential risks of mercury in it, and it can be eaten safely in moderate amounts.
 
It is recommended to eat canned sardines that are packed in water, as their mercury level is lower than the types packed in oil. Pregnant or breastfeeding women can eat sardines in moderate quantities, ranging between 2-3 meals per week. A doctor should be consulted if the woman suffers from any health condition that requires restricting her intake of fish.

Question: اريد اسم برشام لعلاج الشره العصبي
Answer:
الشره المرضي العصبي: هو اضطراب غذائي خطير قد يهدد الحياة، حيث يعاني المرضى من الإفراط في تناول الطعام سراً، و تناول كميات كبيرة من الطعام مع فقدان السيطرة على الأكل، ثم استخدام الملينات والحقن الشرجية، أو أدوية تسبب القيئ للتخلص من الأكل و السعرات الحرارية الزائدة بطريقة غير صحية.إذا كنت تعاني من أعراض الشره المرضي، فمن المهم استشارة طبيب الأمراض النفسية حتى يصف العلاج المناسب لحالتك، والاستعانة بصديق أو فريق دعم يساعدك في اتخاذ الخطوات الأولى.عندما يكون لديك الشره المرضي، فقد تحتاج إلى عدة أنواع من العلاج وليس الدوائي فقط مثل:

العلاج النفسي: وهو يشمل العلاج بالكلام أو الاستشارة النفسية، ومناقشة الشره المرضي، وكذلك العلاج السلوكي المعرفي.
الأدوية: قد تساعد مضادات الاكتئاب في تقليل أعراض الشره المرضي عند استخدامها مع العلاج النفسي مثل: مثبطات امتصاص السيروتونين الانتقائية (SSRI) كأقراص الفلوكستين والتي قد تساعد حتى إذا لم تكن مكتئبًا.
تعليم العادات الغذائية: يمكن لأخصائي التغذية تصميم خطة طعام تساعد في خلق عادات غذائية صحية لتجنب الجوع والرغبة الشديدة في الأكل.
العلاج في المستشفيات: إذا كانت الأعراض شديدة، مع مضاعفات صحية خطيرة، فقد تحتاج إلى علاج في المستشفى.

لاتخضع لعلاج الشره المرضي بمفردك، و ابحث عن الدعم الطبي والمجتمعي لمساعدتك في التغلب على المشكلة.

Question: انا باخد بريجابالين 75 مج بناء على وصفة الطبيب ولكن أود الاستفسار هل يعتبر بريجابالين من المخدرات؟
Answer:
بريجابالين هو دواء مضاد للصرع ويساهم في التخفيف من الألم العصبي، ويستخدم لعلاج مجموعة متنوعة من الحالات، بما في ذلك الصرع وآلام الأعصاب المصاحبة لمرض السكري، والألم العصبي العضلي، وآلام الظهر المزمنة.
 
عند استخدامه ضمن الجرعات الموصى بها لا يعتبر بريجابالين من المخدرات، ولكن في الجرعات العالية يمكن أن يسبب أعراضًا مشابهة لأعراض المخدرات، مثل النشوة والشعور بالراحة، كما يمكن أن يؤدي إلى الإدمان، خاصةً عند الأشخاص الذين لديهم تاريخ من تعاطي المخدرات أو الكحول.
 
إذا كنت تتناول بريجابالين بناءً على وصفة الطبيب، فمن المهم الالتزام بالجرعة الموصى بها وعدم زيادة الجرعة دون استشارة الطبيب، كما يجب عليك إبلاغ طبيبك إذا كنت تعاني من أي آثار جانبية غير مرغوبة، وفيما يلي بعض النصائح لتجنب إدمان بريجابالين:

تناول الدواء فقط حسب توجيهات الطبيب.
لا تشارك الدواء مع الآخرين.
احفظ الدواء في مكان آمن بعيدًا عن متناول الأطفال.
إذا كنت تعاني من أي آثار جانبية غير مرغوبة، فتحدث إلى طبيبك.

Question_eng: I take Pregabalin 75 mg based on the doctor’s prescription, but I would like to inquire: Is Pregabalin considered a drug?
Answer_eng:
Pregabalin is an antiepileptic drug that helps relieve nerve pain and is used to treat a variety of conditions, including epilepsy, nerve pain associated with diabetes, neuromuscular pain, and chronic back pain.
 
When used within recommended doses, Pregabalin is not considered a drug, but in high doses it can cause drug-like symptoms, such as euphoria and a feeling of relief, and can lead to addiction, especially in people with a history of drug or alcohol abuse.
 
If you are taking Pregabalin based on a doctor’s prescription, it is important to adhere to the recommended dose and not increase the dose without consulting your doctor. You should also inform your doctor if you suffer from any unwanted side effects. Here are some tips to avoid addiction to Pregabalin:

Take medication only as directed by your doctor.
Do not share the medicine with others.
Keep the medicine in a safe place out of the reach of children.
If you experience any unwanted side effects, talk to your doctor.

For more:

Risks of using unlicensed medicines
Common errors in using medications

Question_eng: Reasons for seeing flashes in the eye
Answer_eng:
Feeling or seeing a flash in the eye occurs when the vitreous fluid in the retina shrinks, often as a result of aging.
The flashing sensation may last for weeks or months and last from 10 to 20 minutes. These flashes may also be the result of migraine attacks, which cause spasm of the blood vessels in the brain.
 You should see an ophthalmologist to conduct a clinical examination, have a vision test, and measure eye pressure as soon as you are exposed to these flashes.

Question: ما هى أعراض انتشار السرطان في الجسم
Answer:

ألم أو كسر في حالة انتشار السرطان إلى العظام.
الصداع والدوخة وحدوث النوبات في حال انتشار السرطان إلى الدماغ.

وجود صعوبة أو ألم أثناء التبول.
ظهور دم في البول أو في البراز.
الشعور بالضعف والتعب المستمر.

يجب مراجعة الطبيب بشكل روتيني في حالة الإصابة بمرض السرطان، أو في حالة ظهور أي من هذه الأعراض.

Question_eng: What are the symptoms of the spread of cancer in the body?
Answer_eng:
The symptoms of cancer that appear vary depending on the size of the tumor and the location where it appears or has spread. The most important symptoms that appear are:

Pain or fracture if the cancer has spread to the bone.
Headaches, dizziness, and seizures if the cancer spreads to the brain.
Shortness of breath and persistent cough if the cancer has spread to the lungs.
Jaundice or abdominal swelling appears if the cancer has spread to the liver.
Changes in the size or shape of the breast.
Excessive sweating during the night.
Unexplained weight loss or gain.
Having difficulty or pain while urinating.
Appearance of blood in the urine or stool.
Feeling weak and constantly tired.

You should routinely see your doctor if you have cancer, or if any of these symptoms appear.
For more: Symptoms of cancer according to its type, spread of cancer.
Reference: Symptoms of Cancer, Metastatic Cancer

Increased frequency of the urge to urinate is considered an early symptom of pregnancy in women as a result of an increase in the hormones progesterone and chorionic gonadotropin and as a result of increased pressure on the bladder. However, these symptoms soon disappear or decrease at the beginning of the second trimester of pregnancy. It is worth noting that if a strong desire to urinate is accompanied by other symptoms such as a change in the shape or color of urine, the appearance of a foul odor in the urine, pain when urinating, or a burning sensation when urinating, then you must consult a specialist doctor immediately so that he can perform a urine analysis to confirm the presence of bacteria and Take pictures of the kidneys and ensure they are healthy.
It is recommended to visit a doctor so that he can detect the presence of an infection and prescribe a treatment appropriate to the current period of pregnancy to avoid any serious complications.

Question_eng: I have been suffering from prostate enlargement for a year, and thank God I have been treated, but not 100%. I have been suffering for about a month with a slight burning sensation in the penis. My question is: What is the best treatment for enlarged prostate...
Answer_eng:
Prostatitis may be acute or chronic, and is an inflammation or swelling of the prostate gland accompanied by symptoms such as pain, difficulty urinating, a strong desire to urinate, pain during urination, discharge from the penis, or erectile dysfunction. If any of these symptoms appear, you must see a doctor to examine the genital area and perform some necessary tests. Treatment of prostatitis using painkillers and some appropriate antibiotics, depending on the type of inflammation, lasts for 2-4 weeks in the case of acute prostatitis. In the case of chronic prostatitis, pain relievers, antibiotics, and some medications that act as alpha-receptor blockers are used.
In the case of benign prostatic hyperplasia, the diagnosis is made through clinical examinations, blood tests, and some pictures. It is worth noting that prostate enlargement is a common condition that occurs as men age, which leads to preventing the flow of urine and thus causing problems in the urinary tract or kidneys. Treatment for this condition depends on age, general health, and the extent of the enlargement, and includes alpha-receptor blockers such as alfazosin, tamsulosin, etc., or tadalafil, or medications that act as a 5-alpha reductase inhibitor, such as finasteride.
Reference: Prostatitis / What Is BPH?

Answer_eng:
The question: Does mint raise blood pressure is one of the most common questions on the minds of people with high blood pressure, as mint is a type of herb that is used for digestive system disorders and other uses.
Peppermint can affect blood pressure values ​​if it is not used with caution, as it causes an increase in blood pressure and may conflict with the blood pressure treatment medications used, which increases their effect and causes a significant reduction in blood pressure, or interferes with their effect and causes an increase in blood pressure. Therefore, you must consult a specialist doctor before using any herbs with blood pressure medications.
But on the other hand, it was shown through a study conducted on rats that using mint can reduce systolic and diastolic blood pressure, but more studies are needed to confirm the effect. To avoid any negative effects and complications, it is recommended to use mint in moderation and monitor blood pressure readings regularly.

Question_eng: Does stress cause facial swelling?
Answer_eng:
The answer to the question: Does stress cause facial swelling is not specific, as there are many health conditions that cause facial swelling, including high blood pressure during pregnancy or what is called preeclampsia.
Facial swelling may also result from many other causes, including:

Taking a blood pressure medication that belongs to the group of competitive angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors, such as enalprine.
Taking a blood pressure medication that belongs to the group of angiotensin II receptor blockers, such as valsartan.
Taking a medication such as hormonal medications, non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs, etc.
Allergy resulting from taking a medication or food.
Exposure to an insect bite.
Sunburn.
Angioedema.
Sinusitis.

Sudden facial swelling is a symptom that is difficult to ignore, so you must visit a specialist doctor as soon as possible.

Question_eng: I had a kidney transplant two years ago and I take cortisone, 10 mg, the standard for blood sugar. I fasted for 10 hours and found my fasting blood sugar to be 0.62. Two hours after eating breakfast I found it to be 1.16, but sometimes I find it to be 1.62. Is it diabetes?
Answer_eng:
It should be known that cortisone leads to high blood sugar levels as a side effect, and it should be used under the supervision of a specialist doctor only in special cases. As for blood sugar levels, they should be in a healthy person as follows:

Fasting sugar: less than 100 mg/dl (5.6 mmol/L): This means that the reading of 0.62 is very low, and this means low blood sugar.
Blood sugar test 1-2 hours after eating: less than 140 mg/dl (7.8 mmol/L): This means that a reading of 1.16 and 1.62 is low and means low blood sugar.
Cumulative sugar: less than 5.6%.

It is preferable to mention the unit for measuring blood sugar levels, perform a cumulative sugar analysis, and mention the symptoms that you suffer from during the day, along with consulting a specialist doctor and continuous follow-up.

Question_eng: I am pregnant and have endometriosis in my abdominal muscle. Can I perform an operation on her during a cesarean section without any risk?
Answer_eng:
The responsible physician should be consulted about the possibility of performing surgery to treat endometriosis during a cesarean section. Doctors prefer two main types of surgical operations to treat endometriosis, and these types are:

Partial resection, during which as much of the migrating tissue as possible is removed while preserving the ovaries and uterus.
Total removal of the uterus and ovaries, which is performed in cases of severe endometriosis, thus depriving the woman of pregnancy.

It should be noted that the option of surgery does not guarantee a final cure for the condition, due to the possibility that some of the migrated tissue will remain and grow later. It is usually resorted to in two cases:

If the injury is severe, the pain is severe, and the affected person does not respond to drug treatments.
Inability to get pregnant despite trying.

It must be taken into account that the caesarean section itself may increase the risk of endometriosis at the site of the operation.

Colic persists for long periods.
Colic severity and intensity increase over time.
Bleeding.

Heartburn and indigestion.
Back pain.
Constipation and bloating.

Changing positions while sitting or sleeping to get the best clarity reduces pain.

Question_eng: Does Betaserc medicine for dizziness raise my blood pressure? Because when I take it, my blood pressure increases. Thank you very much.
Answer_eng:
There are many questions regarding Betaserc treatment, the most prominent of which is Does Betaserc raise blood pressure, and what is the relationship between Betaserc and blood pressure? And many other questions.
 
It should be noted at the outset that Betaserc contains the active ingredient betahistine, and is used to treat Meniere's disease and its symptoms, which may include dizziness, tinnitus, hearing loss, nausea, and others. It is advised to be careful when using Betaserc when blood pressure is low, and do not use Betaserc when blood pressure is high. 
 
It should be noted that Betaserc treatment cannot be used by patients who suffer from any of the following conditions:

High blood pressure as a result of a tumor in the adrenal gland, as betahistine is an agent similar to histamine, which may lead to the release of catecholamines, especially in the case of pheochromocytoma, which leads to a severe increase in blood pressure.
asthma.
Stomach ulcer.
Allergy to the active ingredient in the medication, or any of its components.

If you suffer from high blood pressure when taking Betaserc, you should consult a doctor immediately.

Question_eng: Does taking vitamin E or E supplements negatively affect the body or have side effects?
Answer_eng:
Yes, taking vitamin E supplements in large quantities can negatively affect the body and may lead to the development of side effects, so it is recommended not to take vitamin E supplements in quantities higher than the recommended daily dose, which ranges between 15-19 mg for adults.
Below I will show you some common side effects of taking high doses of vitamin E:

Increased risk of bleeding, especially in people taking anticoagulant medications such as aspirin.
High amounts of vitamin E affect the digestive system and cause symptoms such as nausea, diarrhea, and vomiting.
Taking high doses of vitamin E can increase the risk of certain diseases such as cancer, heart disease, and blood vessels.
Vitamin E can interact with a number of medications, such as anticoagulants, antibiotics, and cholesterol medications, increasing the risk of negative interactions.

It is recommended not to take high doses of vitamin E, and you should consult a doctor before taking vitamin E supplements if you suffer from any health problems or take any medications permanently.

Answer_eng:
You must see a specialist doctor so that he can take an ovarian scan to confirm the disappearance of ovarian cysts and determine the presence of any other problem that hinders and delays pregnancy, such as endometriosis, or the presence of other hormonal disorders that lead to certain problems, such as polycystic ovary syndrome. However, if ovulation returns to normal by following it up with an ovulation test or through signs of ovulation, the probability of pregnancy is high and fairly certain, with confirmation that there are no other disorders.
Knowing that some studies have proven that if ovulation is healthy, the woman should not face any problem with pregnancy, or that after eliminating any hormonal disorders and the disappearance of the ovarian cyst, it may take a period of several weeks before returning to the ability to become pregnant. To increase your ability to get pregnant, you can follow the following tips:

Follow a healthy and balanced diet.
Do regular exercise, at least half an hour a day, 3-5 days a week.
stop smoking.
Get enough uninterrupted sleep at night.
Take nutritional supplements that contain folic acid.

Question_eng: Peace be upon you.. I want a dermatologist to give me the necessary medications (prescription) to treat ringworm of the thigh (Tinea Cruris). Please, doctor, how long does the treatment last until the disease disappears completely?
Answer_eng:
Ringworm of the ringworm, also known as jock itch (ringworm of the ringworm), is a fungal skin infection that must be treated under the supervision of a specialist doctor. Treatment includes all of the following:

Topical creams containing an active ingredient with an antifungal effect, such as terbinafine, miconazole, clotrimazole, ketoconazole, or econazole, twice daily for 10-14 days.
Consult a specialist doctor about the need to use a topical cream containing cortisone for a few days in conjunction with the antifungal cream.
Apply the topical cream to the affected area and approximately 4-6 cm around it in healthy skin.
Consult a specialist doctor if the situation worsens or does not appear to improve, or in severe or widespread cases, to determine the need to take an oral antifungal for approximately 3-6 weeks.
Wash the area with warm water, dry it well, and keep the area dry throughout the day.
Change underwear daily, especially when sweating.
Avoid sharing towels or personal items with others.
Wear clothing made of cotton and suitable for the weather to reduce sweating in the area as much as possible.

Question_eng: The reason for black blood bleeding is a week after menstruation and the black blood continues for 5 days
Answer_eng:
Black discharge or black blood after menstruation may seem alarming, but it is not always so. Black blood after menstruation may indicate many conditions, including the following:

Menstrual blood retention, or the blood needing additional time to exit the uterus, as it oxidizes and changes color from red to dark brown or black.
The presence of remnants of blood from the previous menstrual cycle, where menstrual blood flow is slow.
The presence of abnormalities in the cervix.
Inflammatory pelvic disease.
Bleeding occurs in the early stages of pregnancy as a result of the implantation of the egg in the uterine lining.
The presence of something or a foreign body stuck in the vagina, such as tampons, condoms, etc.
Unnoticed miscarriage occurs when the fetus dies and remains inside the uterus for 4 weeks or more.
The presence of cervical cancer, but it is considered a rare case.
A woman is infected with a type of sexually transmitted disease, especially chlamydia or gonorrhea.

You should consult a specialist doctor if black blood occurs after your menstrual period, in order to evaluate the condition and determine the cause and appropriate treatment, especially if any of the following symptoms appear:

fever.
Thick vaginal discharge.
Foul-smelling vaginal discharge.
Severe abdominal cramps.
Chronic pelvic pain.

Question_eng: What is the relationship between gestational diabetes and premature birth?
Answer_eng:
Most women with gestational diabetes can have a healthy pregnancy and give birth to healthy babies by keeping their diabetes under control to reduce the risk of developing complications during pregnancy or preventing the development of any of the complications of gestational diabetes. However, complex and irregular gestational diabetes can increase the risk of Pregnancy problems occur, so it requires careful monitoring to reduce these problems.
Women who suffer from gestational diabetes may wonder whether gestational diabetes causes premature birth. The answer to this question is yes, as high levels of blood sugar can increase the risk of premature birth. The risk of premature birth increases if the mother develops gestational diabetes before the twenty-fourth week of pregnancy. . Gestational diabetes is also associated with many other risks and complications, including:

Giving birth to a baby with a large weight.
Having problems during childbirth.
Eclampsia.
Increased fluid volume around the fetus.
Death of the fetus when birth approaches.
The most common problem is low blood sugar in the baby after birth.
The need to resort to emergency caesarean section or induce labor.

The risk of premature birth as a result of gestational diabetes can be reduced by following the following tips:

Conduct gestational diabetes tests early in pregnancy, especially if risk factors are present.
Follow a healthy and balanced diet.
Do exercise regularly.
See your doctor periodically.
Adherence to the medications prescribed by the specialist doctor.
Monitor your blood sugar readings regularly.

Muscle spasm.
arthritis.
Neck injury.
Spinal problems.

Get enough rest.
Apply warm or cold compresses to the neck.

Avoid activities that aggravate the pain.

Question_eng: What are the symptoms of sinusitis and how do I know if I have a sinusitis?
Answer_eng:
Symptoms of sinusitis may vary from person to person, and may be mild or severe. They usually begin a few days after a cold or other upper respiratory infection. Symptoms of sinusitis may include:


Runny or stuffy nose.
Pain or pressure in the face, especially around the eyes, forehead, or cheeks.
Headache.
teeth pain.
Bad taste in the mouth.
Difficulty sleeping.
fever.
Snoring during sleep.

If you are experiencing any of these symptoms, you may have sinusitis, but the best way to confirm whether you have sinusitis is to see a doctor to perform the necessary diagnostic tests.
 
Your doctor can diagnose sinusitis by conducting a physical examination and asking some questions about your symptoms. In some cases, your doctor may also order other tests, such as X-rays or computed tomography (CT), to determine the cause of sinusitis and its extent.
 
Treatment for sinusitis depends on the cause. If sinusitis is caused by a viral infection, the doctor may recommend painkillers and antihistamines. If sinusitis is caused by a bacterial infection, the doctor may prescribe antibiotics.

Answer:
لا يعتمد اضطراب التوازن في الجسم على قصور في غدة معينة بل يمكن أن يتعدى الغدد ويشمل اضطرابات في الجهاز العصبي وغيرها وهذا يستدعي زيارة الطبيب عند الشعور بعدم التوازن من أجل عمل تحاليل شاملة للهرمونات وعمل الفحوصات والصور اللازمة. ولكن من الجدير بالذكر أن عدم توازن الجسم قد يكون بسبب وجود اضطراب في الغدة النخامية التي تقع في قاعدة الدماغ والتي تعمل على إفراز هرمونات تتحكم بهرمونات الغدة الدرقية وجار الدرقية والغدة النخامية وغيرها.

Question_eng: Are there glands that, when deficient, cause imbalance in the body?
Answer_eng:
An imbalance in the body does not depend on a deficiency in a specific gland, but rather it can extend beyond the glands and include disturbances in the nervous system and others. This requires a visit to the doctor when feeling an imbalance in order to conduct comprehensive analyzes of hormones and carry out the necessary examinations and pictures. But it is worth noting that the imbalance in the body may be due to a disorder in the pituitary gland, which is located at the base of the brain and which works to secrete hormones that control the hormones of the thyroid, parathyroid, pituitary, and others. 
It is recommended to go to the doctor immediately because the treatment of glandular disorders is complex, as a change in one hormone level can affect other hormones before any unwanted complications occur.

Question_eng:
I am in my second month of pregnancy, and during the last two weeks a rash appeared all over my body. After consulting several doctors, the final diagnosis was that I suffer from psoriasis of pregnancy.
Does this disease harm the fetus?
Answer_eng:
There is no such thing as psoriasis of pregnancy, but there is a patient with psoriasis who is pregnant
Psoriasis is a hereditary and chronic disease,
On the other hand, pregnancy has a varying effect on psoriasis. In approximately 60% of cases, psoriasis improves during pregnancy. In approximately 30% of cases, psoriasis increases during pregnancy.
In approximately 10% of cases, psoriasis complications occur during pregnancy. None of them can be predicted even by the same pregnant woman. During pregnancy, the use of some medications is prohibited in terms of quantity or quality, and among these medications are strong cortisone such as Dermovate and Diprosalic.
As for using it on small areas, in small quantities, and for short periods, there is nothing wrong with that.
Therefore, you should consult a dermatologist

Answer_eng:
There are many different reasons that lead to clogged pores that cause pimples to appear under the skin, including hormonal changes, bacterial infections, increased oil production in the skin, accumulation of dead skin cells, non-growing hair follicles, and many others.  There are many different types of pimples that appear under the skin, the most prominent of which are the following:

black heads.
Whiteheads.
Warts.
Nodules.
Abscess.

It should be noted that it is possible to develop several types of pimples under the skin at the same time, and the correct diagnosis must be determined by a specialist doctor in order to determine the appropriate treatment. Pimples under the skin may not be noticed, but they appear in the form of swelling many times, with little From pain.
You can get rid of pimples under the skin by following the following tips:

Avoid pressing on pimples under the skin or trying to empty them, as this may exacerbate inflammation, increase pain and signs of redness on the skin, and scars may form in the future.
Apply warm compresses to the pimples under the skin for 10-15 minutes, 4 times daily, to promote the healing of pimples under the skin and facilitate the exit of pus, if any.
Use special bandages or plasters placed on pimples, as they help get rid of bacteria, excess secretions, and dirt, making sure to change them at least every 24 hours.
Consult your doctor about the need to apply topical antibiotics to reduce inflammation, such as clindamycin and erythromycin with or without benzoyl peroxide.
Use tea tree oil on pimples under the skin.
Alleviate the pain associated with pimples under the skin by applying an ice pack for 5 minutes several times daily.
Use a skin-friendly lotion and use it twice daily.
Avoid exfoliating the skin.

It is recommended to consult a specialist doctor in the event of repeated appearance of pimples under the skin or if they are accompanied by severe symptoms in order to determine the appropriate treatment method.

Question: ما مخاطر تكيس المبايض وهل ممكن يسبب سرطان؟
Answer:
تكيس المبايض هو اضطراب هرموني شائع يصيب النساء في سن الإنجاب، ويتميز بظهور حويصلات صغيرة مملوءة بالسوائل في المبايض. يمكن أن تؤدي متلازمة تكيس المبايض إلى مجموعة من المشاكل الصحية، بما في ذلك:

صعوبة الحمل: يمكن أن تجعل متلازمة تكيس المبايض من الصعب على المرأة الحمل، حيث يمكن أن تؤدي إلى عدم انتظام الدورة الشهرية أو انقطاعها.
زيادة الوزن: تعاني النساء المصابات بمتلازمة تكيس المبايض غالبًا من زيادة الوزن أو السمنة.
حب الشباب: يمكن أن تسبب متلازمة تكيس المبايض حب الشباب، خاصةً على الوجه والذقن.
نمو الشعر الزائد: يمكن أن تسبب متلازمة تكيس المبايض نمو الشعر الزائد في الوجه والجسم، خاصةً في منطقة اللحية والشارب.
زيادة خطر الإصابة ببعض الأمراض المزمنة: يمكن أن تزيد متلازمة تكيس المبايض من خطر الإصابة ببعض الأمراض المزمنة، مثل مرض السكري من النوع الثاني، وأمراض القلب والأوعية الدموية، والسكتة الدماغية.

أما فيما يتعلق بإمكانية أن يسبب تكيس المبايض سرطان، فهناك بعض الدراسات التي تشير إلى أن النساء المصابات بمتلازمة تكيس المبايض أكثر عرضة للإصابة ببعض أنواع السرطان، مثل سرطان بطانة الرحم وسرطان الثدي. ومع ذلك، فإن هذه الدراسات ليست حاسمة، ولا يزال هناك حاجة إلى إجراء المزيد من الأبحاث لتأكيد هذه العلاقة.
 
بشكل عام، فإن مخاطر تكيس المبايض تعتمد على شدة الحالة والعوامل الأخرى، مثل العمر ووزن الجسم والتاريخ العائلي. إذا كنت تعانين من تكيس المبايض، فمن المهم استشارة الطبيب لمناقشة مخاطرك وتحديد أفضل خيارات العلاج.

Overweight: Women with PCOS are often overweight or obese.
Acne: PCOS can cause acne, especially on the face and chin.
Excessive hair growth: Polycystic ovary syndrome can cause excessive hair growth on the face and body, especially in the beard and mustache area.
Increased risk of some chronic diseases: Polycystic ovary syndrome can increase the risk of some chronic diseases, such as type 2 diabetes, cardiovascular disease, and stroke.

As for the possibility of polycystic ovary syndrome causing cancer, there are some studies that indicate that women with polycystic ovary syndrome are more susceptible to developing some types of cancer, such as endometrial cancer and breast cancer. However, these studies are not conclusive, and more research is still needed to confirm this relationship.
 
In general, the risks of PCOS depend on the severity of the condition and other factors, such as age, body weight, and family history. If you have polycystic ovary syndrome, it is important to consult a doctor to discuss your risks and determine the best treatment options.

تستهدف أجهزة الليزر لإزالة الشعر بصيلات الشعر، وقد يعاني الشخص بعد الليزر في أي من مناطق الجسم من درجات حروق الليزر المحتلفة التي تظهر على شكل تهيج البشرة يرافقه الاحمرار وقد يعاني من حروق من الدرجة الأولى مشابهة لحروق الشمس.

تناول مسكنات الألم التي تباع بدون وصفة طبية مثل الباراسيتامول أو الايبوبروفين للتخفيف من الألم.

Answer:
يزيد الحمل من فرصة حدوث جلطة دموية من 4-5 أضعاف، حيث أن هرمونات الحمل ترفع من كثافة الدم، و تزيد من حدوث تجلط الأوردة العميقة، ويتم اللجوء ابر المميع للحامل في الحالات التالية:

النساء اللواتي أصبن بتجلط الدم في الماضي ويتناولن مضاد للتخثر.
النساء اللواتي أصبن بتجلط الدم في الماضي، ولكنهن لا يخضعن حالياً لعلاج مضاد التخثر.
النساء اللواتي يصبن بتجلط الدم أثناء الحمل يجب عليهن البدء بتناول أدوية منع تخثر الدم.

تعد أشهر حالات تناول ابر مسيله للدم للحامل:

النساء الحوامل اللائي قمن باستبدال صمامات القلب بأخرى تعويضية، والرجفان الأذيني، واختلال البطين الأيسر.
الحوامل ذوات التاريخ المرضي للسكتات الدماغية، وجلطات الجيب الوريدي الدماغي.
بعض النساء المصابات بالإجهاض وفقدان الجنين المبكر و الإجهاض المتكرر.

تستخدم ابر مميع الدم للحامل بشكل يومي لضمان عدم حدوث جلطة دموية تؤدي إلى إغلاق الطريق الذي يوصل الدم من الأم إلى الجنين، ومن ثم موت الجنين.
تشمل الأدوية التي تستخدم في علاج التخثر عند الحامل:

انوكسابارين: (بالإنجليزية  Enoxaparin sodium ) من مجموعة الهيبارين الجزئي وتعرف باسم : ابر flenox، و الكلكسان.

استخدام ابر flenox للحامل آمن تماماً وتعتبر ابر تحت الجلد flenox عبارة عن ابر لا تتسبب في مضاعفات للأم و الجنين، كذلك استخدام ابرة clexane للحامل؛ ولكن يجب أن يكون تحت إشراف الطبيب الكامل.

تنزابارين: (بالإنجليزية: Tinzaparin) من مجموعة الهيبارين منخفض الوزن الجزيئي، ومن أشهرها ابر innohep للحامل أي ابر innohep 3500 للحامل.

يتميز استخدام innohep 3500 للحامل طريقة تخزينه إذ يمكن حفظه في درجة حرارة الغرفة.

بيميبارين: من الجيل التاني من عائلة الهيبارين منخفض الجزئية، ويعرف باسم ابر هايبور للحامل.

يعد استخدام ابر هايبور 3500 للحامل آمن، ويصاحب معدل ولادات حية مرتفع، ولا توجد مضاعفات على الأم والجنين.
لا تعد أدوية علاج التخثر التي تؤخذ عن طريق الفم آمنة مثل الوارفرين، فقد يكون لها تأثير على الجنين خلال الحمل، وبالتالي من المهم اللجوء إلى ابر تخثر الدم للحامل مثل: الهيبارين والكلكسان.
تستخدم ابر الهيبارين لتثبيت الحمل، وتعطى عن طريق ابر تحت الجلد للحامل بصورة دورية؛ ولكن يجب متابعة الجرعات بتحاليل مستمرة لسيولة الدم.
استخدام ابر مميع الدم للحامل أو ابر تجلط الدم للحامل غير مضر للجنين؛ فهي لا تعبر المشيمة، ولا تدخل مجرى الدم الخاص بالجنين؛ ولا يؤدي إلى حدوث عيوب خلقية أو مشاكل في النزيف لذلك يعد آمن خلال الحمل.
يجب استشارة الطبيب المختص بالأمراض النسائية قبل استخدام أي ابر مسيلة للدم أو ابر تحت الجلد للحمل، وذلك لضمان أن ابر التخثر للحامل المستخدمة أو أي ابرة تحت الجلد للحامل تستخدم بشكل آمن وأن ابرة تخثر الدم للحامل لا تسبب اي مضاعفات غير مرغوبة.

Question_eng: Why should pregnant women inject subcutaneous needles every day to treat blood clotting?
Answer_eng:
Pregnancy increases the chance of a blood clot occurring 4-5 times, as pregnancy hormones increase blood density and increase the incidence of deep vein thrombosis, and liquefaction needles are used for pregnant women in the following cases:

Women who have had a blood clot in the past and are taking an anticoagulant.
Women who have had blood clots in the past, but are not currently undergoing anticoagulant treatment.
Women who develop blood clots during pregnancy should start taking anticoagulation medications.

The most common cases of pregnant women taking blood thinner needles are:

Pregnant women who have had heart valves replaced with prosthetic ones, atrial fibrillation, and left ventricular dysfunction.
Pregnant women with a medical history of strokes and cerebral venous sinus thromboses.
Some women suffer from miscarriage, early fetal loss, and recurrent miscarriage.

Blood thinner needles are used by pregnant women on a daily basis to ensure that a blood clot does not occur, leading to the closure of the path that connects blood from the mother to the fetus, and thus the death of the fetus.
Medications used to treat thrombosis in pregnant women include:

Enoxaparin: (in English, Enoxaparin sodium) is from the group of partial heparins and is known as: flenox needles and gloxane.

The use of Flenox needles for pregnant women is completely safe. Flenox hypodermic needles are needles that do not cause complications for the mother and fetus. Likewise, the use of Clexane needles for pregnant women. But it must be under the full supervision of a doctor.

Tinzaparin: (in English: Tinzaparin) is from the group of low molecular weight heparins, and the most famous of them is Innohep needles for pregnant women, i.e. Innohep 3500 needles for pregnant women.

Using innohep 3500 for pregnant women is characterized by its storage method, as it can be kept at room temperature.

Pemiparin: It is from the second generation of the low-molecular heparin family, and is known as HyperHyper for pregnant women.

The use of HyperHyper 3500 by pregnant women is safe, and is accompanied by a high live birth rate, and there are no complications for the mother and fetus.
Oral anticoagulant medications are not as safe as warfarin, as they may have an effect on the fetus during pregnancy, and therefore it is important to resort to blood clotting needles for pregnant women, such as: heparin and Clexane.
Heparin injections are used to stabilize pregnancy, and are given through subcutaneous needles to the pregnant woman periodically. However, doses must be followed up with continuous blood thinner tests.
The use of blood thinner needles for pregnant women or blood clotting needles for pregnant women is not harmful to the fetus. It does not cross the placenta, nor does it enter the fetus's bloodstream. It does not lead to birth defects or bleeding problems, so it is considered safe during pregnancy.
A gynecologist must be consulted before using any blood-thinning needles or hypodermic needles during pregnancy, in order to ensure that the blood-thinning needles for pregnant women used or any hypodermic needles for pregnant women are used safely and that the blood-thinning needles for pregnant women do not cause any unwanted complications.
